purpose: Diagnose candidate incompleteness and a separate intentional instrument mismatch using already-paid E1 fields
scientific_iteration: E2 diagnosis within the current stage; no new scientific iteration or physical campaign
population: all32 existing E1 parents, both noise episodes; explicitly exposed followup

support_definitions.combined_deleted: exclude candidates with both central radius and annular halfwidth positive

action_menu: six frozen E1 frequencies plus paid-reference calibration statistic; one new block at most
selection: joint bounded-gain profile over retained candidates; one gain per material across complete observation history
sentinel: fixed3.2 acquisition plus diagnostic abstention if minimum joint residual exceeds heuristic chi2(.99,D-1); same measurement as fixed3.2, not a new ranking algorithm

scenarios.in_model: original E1 persistent real gain and independent potential-outcome noise
scenarios.instrument_gain_drift: future scattering gain = old_gain*(1+.03*(k-1.6)); unchanged Maxwell field and same saved noise, calibration at1.6 unchanged; fitted model intentionally still assumes one shared bounded gain

material_metric: exact R=1 volume-weighted componentwise relative-epsilon L1, s_ref1
statistical_unit: 32 parents; average both noise episodes before paired comparisons
